notes.title: Axes and Acres Patch 1.08 (Quality of Life + HOTKEYS)
notes.content:
Windows only for now.

-Discard now shuffles when you run through the deck
-Fixed a couple popup typos (FUTHER victory, forest fires destoyed, etc)
-Fixed the ? screen goal in advanced mode
-Fixed some sound/mute setting issues
-Clicking objective cards mistakenly should no longer trigger anything on the board
-Esc key now closes the "Quit" popup
-Dice are now sorted by face and then type

ADDED HOTKEYS
-[TAB] to cycle through buildings
-[1-5] to select buildings
-[Q or B] to select next Build die
-[W] to select next Work die
-[E or G] to select next Gather die
-[R] to select next Reproduce die
-[C] to select next Crusade die
-[D] to select next Wild die (W was taken)

-[M or T] to use a die for movement
-[S] to save a die for movement

notes.title: 1.08c (Card Hotkeys)
notes.content:
Added Hotkeys to use cards in hand.

Shift + 1 (first card)
Shift + 2 (second card)
Shift + 3 (third card)

(Still on beta branch and only on windows)

Thanks to KwirkyJ from the Braingoodgames discord for the suggestion.

notes.title: 1.08b (Reproduction Hotkey Hotfix)
notes.content: Fixed a bug with using the hotkeys while selecting a second reproduction die.

notes.title: Patch 1.05 - "Age of Castles" is LIVE!
notes.content:
Go forth and spread your buildings far and wide, and bask in the grandeur of your kingdom! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22311001/f2204457d70fb7f4a949bc81917c0f8a1cff9588.png[/img]

Patch 1.05 features a ton of balance tweaks and quality of life reworks, as well as a big leaderboard update and a second major end-game win condition in the Castle!

You can read the full patch notes here:
http://blog.braingoodgames.com/2017/03/09/axes-and-acres-patch-1-05/

In other news, we have a 100% positive Steam rating for the first time in Axes and Acres young life! Pretty cool!

Thank you all for your continued support, you make this adventure awesome! As always, you can leave a comment here with your feedback or reach me at braingoodgames@gmail.com.

notes.title: "Saving and Learning" (v1.01) Update Is Live!
notes.content:
The people have spoken, and they want to suspend their games! So we've added saving in the new update, along with a number of tutorial tweaks and bugfixes. Partial feature list to follow.

Thank you all so much for your amazing feedback and support. As always, you can email us at braingoodgames (at) gmail.com, or leave a comment below with your questions, comments and suggestions. Keep the feedback coming, and if you haven't yet, please leave a review on Steam, it really helps a lot!

-Suspending games implemented
-Draggable popup boxes
-Cancel some popup boxes during play
-Tutorial language clarifications
-Objective language clarifications
-Renamed "Builders" to "Masons"
-Made it more clear when a die selected for movement
-Made it more clear when resources are on the same space as workers
-More explanation of the goal in ranked.
-Made supply explanation more clear
-Added option to manually set you rank to either 1 or 5 in settings
-Added barbarian clarification popup
-Added alert for when you're low on rounds
-Fixed a couple typos
-Fixed a bug that caused corrupted save files
-...Many small tweaks + bugfixes

We can't wait to hear your questions, comments and suggestions as we push forward to make Axes and Acres the best game it can be! Stay tuned for a balance/content update some time in the near future!

Edit:
-1.01a Save feature bugfixes
-1.01b Fixed bug with Builder's Hall saves, skip fade when resuming
-1.01c Fixed bug with barbarian spawners appearing on constructing buildings
1.01d Fixed bug with cancelling wild die deploy dialog. You can now undo deploy actions (as long as you haven't done something else).
1.01e Fixed bug with advanced tutorial, potential fix for "ghost dice"

P.S Militia is on sale this week for 33% off on the Humble Store! ($4 USD!)
https://www.humblebundle.com/store/p/militia_storefront
